$comment: SHRINK-ONLY coverage-ratchet allowlist (cinatra#985; aspect granularity since cinatra#986). An entry WITHOUT `aspects` exempts the whole surface from functional-acceptance coverage FOR NOW; an entry WITH `aspects` ("field:<name>" / "action:<name>" / "state:<state>") exempts ONLY those aspects of an otherwise-covered surface — every other annotated field binding, action, and state variant with no assertion is a RED. CI (scripts/design/check-conformance-ratchet.mjs) enforces monotonicity against the PR base at (surface, aspect) granularity: entries/aspects may be REMOVED (as coverage lands) or a whole-surface entry NARROWED to aspects, but never added, re-added, or widened. Each entry names the manifest it belongs to and why it is not yet covered.

allow.reason: Marketplace browse surfaces storefront failures LOUDLY by design (src/lib/marketplace-browse.ts throws; no in-surface error treatment exists on the route) — cover the error variant when the surface gains a real error presentation. empty/loading + exact cardinality are covered on the seeded harness (cinatra#986).

The §VI screen renders server-side with no distinct in-surface error or loading treatment (reads throw to the route boundary; no streaming fallback exists in RegistryCatalogScreen) — cover when those presentations exist. empty + exact cardinality + the status filter are covered from the LIVE seeded canonical store (cinatra#986).

/connectors renders a bare grid when zero cards match (ConnectorsClient has no designed empty state) and is server-rendered without a streaming fallback — cover when those presentations exist. The name binding, exact cardinality, the connection filter, and the fail-soft error card (cinatra#110 containment) are covered on the seeded harness (cinatra#986).
